examples.text: Tuż po starcie elity off-roadu, czyli klasy No Limit, doszło do groźnie wyglądającej wywrotki. Jeden z samochodów podskoczył na nierówności, a potem przekoziołkował.

glosses: A movement in which one's body is rolled forward, by putting the head on the ground and swinging the legs over the head.
Starting on one's feet, an instance of rotating one's body 360 degrees while airborne or on the ground, with one's feet passing over one's head.

examples.text: The performer somersaulted all the way across the stage.
He half-carries, half-drags it back to the stern, making sure the heat exchanger stays in the water, and somersaults it into the zodiac.

glosses: Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see flip, over.
